QUIC packet pretty-print context and packet formatting function declaration.

# Purpose
This header file defines the `fd_quic_pretty_print` data structure and the `fd_quic_pretty_print_t` type alias for storing packet context fields. The structure keeps IPv4 source and destination addresses, UDP source and destination ports, a flow direction flag, and a connection index. It also declares [`fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_pkt`](<#fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_pkt>), which takes a packet context, a time value, and a buffer with its size, and returns a `ulong` result after processing a QUIC packet for pretty print output.
# Function Declarations (Public API)
